subject: general
question: An article is sold at a loss of 40%. The nominal amount of loss is approximately what percentage of the selling price of the article?
solution:
Given:

An article is sold at a loss of 40%.

Concept used:

1. Selling Price = Cost Price × (1 - Loss%)

2. Loss% in terms of the selling price = {(Cost Price - Selling Price) over Selling Price} times 100\%

Calculation:

Let the cost price of the article be Rs. 100.

Selling price = 100(1 - 40%) = Rs. 60

Now, loss% in terms of the selling price

⇒ frac {100 - 60}{60} times 100\%

⇒ 66.6666% ≈ 66.67%

**∴ The nominal amount of loss is approximately 66.67% of the selling price of the article.**
